title: The liver
examples: What does the liver do for our blood?
Can the liver help us with digestion?
Does the liver store any kind of energy?

explain.say: The liver has a very important job for your blood.
Now let me show you the real thing in 3D: the digestive system. Look at the oesophagus, the liver and the gall bladder. Tap any part, and I will tell you what it does.
It cleans your blood by filtering out harmful things.
The liver also stores extra energy for later use.
Another big job is making bile to help you digest food.
In real life, the liver keeps your body working smoothly.

draw.text: Real Life: Liver keeps body healthy

explain.say: A common mistake is thinking the liver only cleans blood.

faq.q: What is the main job of the liver?
faq.a: The main job is cleaning the blood and helping with digestion. It also stores energy for your body.
asks: Is the liver important for digestion?

faq.a: Yes, the liver stores extra energy, mainly in the form of glucose, when you eat too much. This energy is used later.
asks: Where does the body keep extra energy?

faq.q: What is bile and what does it do?
faq.a: Bile is a liquid that the liver makes. It helps to break down fats that you eat in your food.
asks: How does the liver help digest fats?
What is the purpose of bile?

faq.q: Does the liver clean all kinds of waste?
faq.a: It filters out many waste products from your blood. This keeps your blood clean and safe for your body.
asks: What does the liver filter out?
Is the liver like a filter?

faq.q: If the liver is not working well, what happens?
faq.a: If the liver does not work well, your blood might not be cleaned properly. This can make your body feel unwell.
asks: What happens if the liver gets sick?
Can the body live without a healthy liver?

facts: The liver is a large organ found in the upper right side of the abdomen.
It filters waste products and toxins from the blood.
It produces bile, which helps break down fats in the small intestine.
The liver stores energy in the form of glycogen, which can be released later.

quiz.say: Which process does the liver perform by filtering waste from the blood?
quiz.why: The liver's primary role is to act as a filter for your blood, removing harmful substances.

wrong.0: This is another important job, but it is not the main filtering process.
wrong.1: Making bile is for digestion, which is a different function.
wrong.2: The heart pumps blood; the liver filters it as it passes through.

quiz.say: If you eat a meal with lots of fats, what substance does the liver help with?
quiz.why: The liver makes bile, which is specifically used in the small intestine to help break down fats.

wrong.0: Oxygen is needed for breathing, not for digesting fats.
wrong.1: Water is needed for many bodily functions, but bile is the specific digestive aid.
wrong.3: Glucose is the stored energy, not the substance that digests fats.

quiz.say: The liver stores extra energy primarily as:
quiz.why: The liver converts excess sugar into glycogen to save it for when your body needs quick energy later.

wrong.0: While it can process fats, its main storage form for quick energy is glycogen.
wrong.1: Oxygen is used in respiration, not stored by the liver.
wrong.2: Amino acids are building blocks for proteins, not the primary energy reserve stored here.
